div.div:
Splitter: Decomposes composite batch into N child items.
Metadata: Injects correlation_id, sequence_number, sequence_size.
Aggregator: Accumulates items until completion predicate or TTL.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 389px; margin-left: 44px;

div.div:
• State Store: In-memory heap or distributed Redis/Cassandra.
• Memory Hazard: Unbounded leak if 1 of N child messages drops.
• Completion Policy: Count-based, timeout-based, or predicate.
• Realization: Apache Flink window, Spring Integration Aggregator.

div.div:
Problem: Parallel worker pools emit messages out-of-order.
Mechanic: Sliding window buffer holds future items.
Release: Emits item k only when items 0..k-1 have been emitted.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 389px; margin-left: 514px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#334155, #acb8c9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
• Window Discipline: Max buffer size W and timeout τ_max.
• Gap Handling: If missing item times out, skip gap or abort.
• Head-of-Line Blocking: A single stalled message halts the stream.
• Realization: TCP receive buffer, Kafka consumer offset alignment.

div.div:
Scatter: Broadcasts request to multiple autonomous suppliers.
Execution: Suppliers calculate quotes independently in parallel.
Gather: Selects best bid (lowest price / fastest delivery).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 389px; margin-left: 984px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#334155, #acb8c9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
• Latency Bound: Governed by slowest respondent or strict deadline.
• Late Responses: Discarded into DLQ or logged as orphans.
• Selection Policy: First-response, minimum cost, or N-quorum.
• Realization: Flight price search aggregators, insurance bidding.

div.div: Coordinated Across Multi-Step Enterprise Business Processes ➔

div.div: 3. DISTRIBUTED COORDINATION: ROUTING SLIP VS. PROCESS MANAGER (SAGA)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 448px; height: 1px; padding-top: 608px; margin-left: 29px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Routing Slip (Decentralized Choreography)
• State Location: Carried directly inside message header itinerary.
• Coupling: Services know only their own step and pop next target.
• Failure Mode: Complex compensation routing; no central ledger.
• Best Fit: Linear validation pipelines, content transformation chains.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 448px; height: 1px; padding-top: 608px; margin-left: 499px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Process Manager / Saga (Centralized Orchestration)
• State Location: Centralized persistent database / state machine.
• Coupling: Services remain generic task workers; coordinator commands them.
• Failure Mode: Executes deterministic reverse compensating actions.
• Best Fit: Multi-party transactions (Order, Payment, Inventory, Shipping).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 448px; height: 1px; padding-top: 608px; margin-left: 969px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000; background-color: #FFFFFF;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; background-color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #121212); white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Enterprise Architectural Invariants
• Memory Finiteness: All stateful buffers (Aggregator, Resequencer) must define strict TTL eviction.
• Correlation Identity: Sub-messages must preserve root correlation ID alongside sequence index.
• Compensating Idempotency: Saga reverse actions must be strictly idempotent under at-least-once delivery.
